title: Tiny, cute croissant
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe8a3' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe8a3' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5b731'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8942a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d47a22'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body2' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a830'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#7a4a1a' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- main crescent body -->
  <path d='M18,56 C14,40 24,24 42,22 C52,21 60,26 64,34 C68,42 66,50 60,54 C54,58 46,56 42,50 C38,44 40,36 46,32 C50,29 56,30 58,34 C60,38 58,42 54,43 C51,44 48,42 48,38'
        fill='url(#body)' stroke='#b56a18' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- lighter inner curve segments -->
  <path d='M22,54 C20,42 28,28 44,26' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30,50 C30,42 36,34 46,32' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40,46 C41,40 46,36 52,35' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right side of croissant -->
  <path d='M64,34 C70,38 72,46 68,54 C64,62 56,66 48,64 C40,62 36,56 36,50'
        fill='url(#body2)' stroke='#b56a18' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- segment lines on right -->
  <path d='M56,36 C60,38 62,42 61,46' fill='none' stroke='#c97a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58,46 C60,50 58,54 54,56' fill='none' stroke='#c97a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50,56 C52,58 52,60 50,62' fill='none' stroke='#c97a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flaky highlight -->
  <path d='M26,40 C28,34 34,28 40,26' fill='none' stroke='#ffe8a3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M48,26 C52,26 56,28 58,32' fill='none' stroke='#ffe8a3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='44' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#5a2e0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='42' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#5a2e0a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f28a5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f28a5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46,50 C48,53 52,53 54,50' fill='none' stroke='#5a2e0a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <path d='M72,28 L74,30 L72,32 L70,30 Z' fill='#ffe8a3' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M20,34 L21.5,35.5 L20,37 L18.5,35.5 Z' fill='#ffe8a3' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
